derivation: perhaps from the same as H3117 (יוֹם); properly, warm, i.e. affectionate; hence, dove (compare H3123 (יוֹנָה));

occurrences.text: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren–happuch.
